As of 2026, he is 19 years old, and his birth date places him under the Cancer sign.
He has represented FC Barcelona and has been recognised with La Liga Player of the Month and Kopa Trophy.

sections.heading: Lamine Yamal — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Lamine Yamal was born on 13 July 2007 in Esplugues de Llobregat, and holds citizenship of Spain, Equatorial Guinea and Morocco. He was given the name Lamine Yamal Nasraoui Ebana at birth and is publicly known as Lamine Yamal.
He is a sibling of Keyne Yamal.
He is recorded as speaking Catalan, Spanish and English.

sections.heading: Lamine Yamal — Career and Professional Work
paras: Lamine Yamal works primarily as an association football player.
On the team sheet, Lamine has been associated with FC Barcelona (from 2023). He plays as a winger.
He has taken part in 2022–23 La Liga, 2023–24 UEFA Champions League, 2023 UEFA European Under-17 Championship, UEFA Euro 2024 qualifying and UEFA Euro 2024.
